title: Google Play Privacy Policy Enricher
description: Provide Google Play app URLs. The actor scrapes app metadata and enriches each record with the full text of the app's Privacy Policy.

startUrls.title: Google Play URLs
startUrls.description: One or more Google Play app detail URLs (e.g. https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=org.khankids.android).

includeReviews.title: Include reviews
includeReviews.description: Whether to include user reviews in the output. Increases run time and cost proportionally.
